title: Control plane provisioner: Terraform EKS module with upgrade safety, IAM rotation, and active health checks
creator: Aisha Khan
description: Create a hardened Terraform module for provisioning Redwood Private control planes on EKS that improves upgrade safety, supports automated IAM key rotation hooks, and exposes active health checks for early detection of control plane regressions. The module should be opinionated but configurable: multi-AZ EKS clusters, immutable control plane rolling approach, safe nodegroup lifecycle, upgrade hooks for KMS/KMS key rotation, and Prometheus-compatible health endpoints. Deliverables include the Terraform module, example usage, CI integration tests, and a migration/runbook for existing clusters.
acceptance_criteria: Terraform module lives under terraform/modules/eks-controlplane and is published to internal registry
Module supports a 'canary_nodegroup' and immutable nodegroup replacement strategy without downtime for stateless control-plane components
Automated IAM rotation hook implemented as optional null_resource plus SSM parameter update flow and documented in runbook
End-to-end CI test creates a cluster in staging, runs upgrade path (minor and patch), validates health probes, and tears down resources
Module exposes healthcheck endpoints and metrics annotations compatible with our Console dashboards
comments: 2026-03-01 - Aisha Khan: Initial ticket created after post-mortem for incident #INC-2026-02 where a control plane upgrade caused transient API errors. Proposal: safer upgrade primitives and active health telemetry.

2026-03-04 - Daniel Ruiz: Spike completed; prototyped immutable nodegroup replacement using lifecycle.create_before_destroy and taints to avoid traffic during rollout. Observed 30s API delay on m5.large control plane during kube-system migration.

2026-03-07 - Eng review: Decided to add optional canary_nodegroup and a preflight job that verifies DNS and API responsiveness before promoting new nodegroup. Also adding an IAM rotation hook that sequences KMS key rotation before control plane certificate refresh.
2026-03-10 - UX/Console sync: Exposed healthcheck and rollout status via annotations so Console can surface per-cluster rollout progress. Added label schema to allow per-tenant filtering.
2026-03-12 - Security review: flagged IAM rotation flow for a formal security review. Marked ticket with security_review_required and created follow-up subtask ENG-14358 for review checklist.

2026-03-14 - Daniel Ruiz: Began writing CI workflow (github.com/redwood-inference/infra/actions/workflows/eks-module-e2e.yml) and example staging vars file. Next: finish runbook and test minor version upgrades.
